classification.blocked: Required engineering/provenance/topology evidence unavailable or failed.
classification.confirmed: Every one of 12 independent GP endpoints satisfies both original gates.
classification.not_confirmed: Complete qualified experiment with at least one endpoint failure.

identity: Retain frozen seed-11 architecture ID and order hash. Physical serialization hash changes with coordinates; never use it as a replacement logical architecture ID.

initialization.evidence: Reject pre-GP input if any movable instance is already placed. Record all original statuses, generated coordinates and hashes. Audit pre-GP against retained source flow commands.
initialization.global_placement: Same installed OpenROAD and ORFS placement constraints. GLOBAL_PLACEMENT_ARGS=-skip_initial_place; hook removes -force_center_initial_place so the fresh initialization is not discarded. Both skip-IO GP and final GP run normally from the new ancestry. No native random_seed support is claimed.
initialization.method: Fresh seeded uniform coordinates in the core for movable instances from the retained unplaced 2_floorplan.odb; no old placed database is read. Python random.Random(29), instances sorted by name, x/y sampled independently. This is initialization, not perturbation of any existing placement.

materiality.purpose: Preregistered descriptive engineering tolerance only, not a significance, accuracy, or power threshold. Zero left denominator => undefined.

placement_dependent_inputs: FF, functional sink, transparent-buffer and port coordinates
spatial bin membership in the fixed 10x10 grid
placement_independent_inputs: packed toggle traces, test patterns and FF mapping
correlation, pair direction, tie rules and gates

routing.flow: Exact qualified phase2c_run downstream route/extraction and repaired topology assertions; adapt source paths only.

statistics: Inherited correlations and compare_pairs; exact ties, ascending average ranks, all unordered pairs; raw Spearman/Kendall/Pearson; no p-values or CI
stop: Any independence, provenance, frozen hash, identity, topology, predictor, target or reproducibility failure stops scientific execution. Preserve attempts. No tuning, optimizer, ATPG, Phase-3 or push.
targets: Unchanged routed wire and extracted ground+coupling+pin capacitance weighted by frozen packed transitions; total and local peak use unchanged score_packed.
